sourceText:
Hot Dog From Karachi
By: miansari66
Published: Thursday, May 19, 2011 - 12:29am

Ingredients




4 Hot dog buns
4 Frank sausage (ready to use)
8 Lettuce leaves fresh
Pickled cucumber (or fresh cucumber) as desired
Tomato slices as desired
Mayonnaise as desired
Mustard sauce as desired
4 Cheese slices
Tomato Ketchup as desired

Preparation

1 Slit buns along length. 2 Apply Mayonnese on both sides. 3 Place 2 Lettuce leaves, Then 1 Frank Sauces, then 1 cheese slice, Insert Cucumber , tomatoes. 4 Apply Mayonnaise, Mustard sauce and Tomato Ketchup and serve. 5 Serving Size 4

About


World Famous hot Dog snack is liked by everyone, very simple to prepare at home
